issues.label: Newly created offenses in plea vs indictment
issues.why: Hampton pleaded guilty to offenses (unlawful possession of dangerous ordnance, obstructing official business, receiving stolen property) not appearing in the original indictment, raising validity questions.

issues.label: Allied offenses of similar import merger
issues.why: Multiple convictions arising from the same accident (two involuntary manslaughter theories, aggravated vehicular homicide, vehicular assault, receiving stolen property) may require merger under R.C. 2941.25.

issues.label: Consecutive sentence findings under R.C. 2929.14(C)(4)
issues.why: The court must make and incorporate statutory findings before imposing consecutive terms for failure to comply, firearm specification, and aggravated vehicular homicide.

issues.label: Mandatory consecutive failure-to-comply sentence
issues.why: R.C. 2921.331(D) requires failure-to-comply sentences run consecutively, and the court's compliance must be verified.

issues.label: Firearm specification sentencing legality
issues.why: The six-year firearm specification attached to unlawful possession of dangerous ordnance must be authorized and properly imposed under R.C. 2929.14(B).

issues.label: Aggravated vehicular homicide sentence length legality
issues.why: A 12-month term for a felony aggravated vehicular homicide may fall outside the statutory range for the offense degree.

issues.label: Involuntary manslaughter felony-degree sentence range
issues.why: The 36-month sentence must conform to the permissible range for first-degree involuntary manslaughter.

issues.label: Reagan Tokes indefinite sentencing applicability
issues.why: Certain qualifying felonies may require indefinite sentences under R.C. 2967.271, affecting the definite terms imposed.

issues.label: Compliance with R.C. 2929.11 and 2929.12
issues.why: The court must properly consider sentencing purposes and seriousness/recidivism factors.

issues.label: Eighth Amendment proportionality of sentence
issues.why: Hampton challenges the sentence as cruel and unusual, requiring proportionality analysis.

issues.label: Crim.R. 11 plea validity and voluntariness
issues.why: A knowing, intelligent, voluntary plea requires proper advisement, especially given non-indicted charges.

issues.label: Post-release control notification
issues.why: Failure to properly notify of mandatory post-release control renders that portion of the sentence contrary to law.

issues.label: Guilty plea waiver of sentencing challenges
issues.why: A valid guilty plea may waive certain non-jurisdictional or allied-offense claims not preserved below.

issues.label: Standard of review for felony sentences
issues.why: R.C. 2953.08(G)(2) limits appellate modification to sentences clearly and convincingly contrary to law.

issues.label: Mandatory driver's license suspension
issues.why: Vehicular offenses require statutory license suspensions that must be properly imposed.

issues.label: Forfeiture specification disposition
issues.why: The forfeiture specifications pleaded to must be properly adjudicated and ordered.

issues.label: Restitution obligations for victims
issues.why: The court may be required to consider or order restitution for injury and death victims.
